name: ANSI/IEEE connector plug half symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for connector plug half, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The separately drawn plug form identifies one side of a detachable connection. The circuit can only be followed completely when its pin number and mating socket reference are preserved across the drawing set.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Find the mating half before treating this endpoint as disconnected.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: An isolated plug-half representation is different from an off-sheet wire continuation arrow.
